title: An API call summary
description:
Summarise a log of the system calls a program made.

```
CreateFileW       3  (settings.ini x2, save.dat)
ReadFile          5
RegOpenKeyExW     1  (HKCU\Software\MyGame)
first network call: none
```
hints: A small table of name prefixes (`Reg`, `Create`/`Read`/`Write`, `connect`/`send`/`WSA`) sorts calls into kinds.
requirements: Log lines are `function(arguments)`; count calls per function and keep distinct first arguments.
Point out network, registry and file activity separately.
stretch: Produce the log on your machine with Process Monitor on a program you wrote.
